name: ayahquest
description: AyahQuest — a Duolingo-style Quran learning app for children and teens. Built on the Quran Foundation Content APIs with a faster-whisper Arabic ASR sidecar for real recitation verification.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --workspace=client && npm install --workspace=server
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n ASR,API,WEB -c magenta,blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.dev:basic: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
